title: Website: record the Hosted or Dedicated tier on the beta waitlist survey
description: The Hosted and Dedicated Request access buttons on chattic.us now link to /beta?tier=hosted and /beta?tier=dedicated (private repo AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web, PR 45), but the survey form has no tier question and nothing records the value. Add one multiple-choice question (Hosted, Dedicated, Not sure) preselected from the tier query parameter, store it with the intake record, and send it as a GA4 sign_up parameter if the analytics conventions allow. This needs a survey and intake backend change in that repo. Acceptance: a lead arriving from the Dedicated button submits and the stored record says dedicated. Gherkin first.
